summary: Shows ansible-lint giving Ansible-specific feedback, e.g. rule 403 flagging package installs that use latest.
questions: How do I lint an Ansible playbook?
Why does ansible-lint complain about state: latest?

answer_card.title: Linting with ansible-lint
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
ansible-lint verify-apache.yml
[403] Package installs should not use latest
```

See the ansible-lint default rules page for what each rule means.
